Jesteśmy najdłużej, stale działającą ligą driftingową w Polsce. Od lat organizujemy zawody na terenie całego kraju, budując wizerunek driftingu jako najbardziej widowiskowego motorsportu, wychowując przy tym kolejne pokolenie mistrzów polskiego driftingu. Home Shop Register Rules Rankings Media About Us Events Qualify Score Drift Kings 2026: 22nd Season Unleashed To the Drift Kings family, the drivers, and every fan across Europe: The wait is over. It is time to ignite the engines for Season 22. Drift Kings has never been just about the trophies; it’s about the legacy, the adrenaline, and the family spirit that unites the paddock. For two decades, we have paved the way for European drifting, and in 2026, we are raising the stakes higher than ever before. We are proud to reveal a calendar that combines the ultimate test of speed with uncharted territories. From the "Green Hell" of Germany to a historic debut in Bulgaria, and a secret battlefield in Poland, this season is built for the brave. HERE IS YOUR OFFICIAL 2026 DRIFT KINGS EUROPEAN TOUR: Winter Training • Serres • Greece • February 14–15 We will open this 2026 Season not with a race, but with an exclusive Winter Training session! Before the war for the championship begins, join us at our homebase, Serres Racing Circuit, on February 14th and 15th. We have prepared two great days of drift training to help you dial in your setups and sharpen your skills. Limited spots are available, and registration is open now at www.driftkings.com/register. Round 1 • Nürburgring • Germany • April 24–26 In partnership with Skylimit Events & Nürburgring Drift Cup. We return to the holy grail of motorsport. A successful partnership enters its third year at the "Green Hell." There is no better place to start the war for the championship. SPECIAL EVENT • Gonco Fest • Bulgaria • May 9–10 The Balkan Drift Cup. HISTORY IN THE MAKING. For the first time ever, Drift Kings brings professional international drifting to Bulgaria. We are joining forces with Gonco Fest to create a true motorsport festival. Expect a massive crowd and electric energy for this stand-alone event held outside the championship. Round 2 • Anneau du Rhin • France • June 12–14 In partnership with Drift Cup MSO. The ultimate test of bravery. Known for the legendary 180kph+ entry speeds, this is where the kings are separated from the contenders. High speed. High risk. High reward. Round 3 • RabócsiRing • Mariapócs, Hungary • July 11–12 In partnership with Drifting.hu and Hunakamo. The Cauldron returns. Famous for the best atmosphere in Europe, Mariapócs is a staple of the series. Will we run the classic line or the technical reverse layout? Stay tuned—the challenge awaits. Round 4 • Trackwood • Hungary • August 28-29 We’re taking it back to Trackwood! ​It’s official: Round 4 is heading to Trackwood. We are thrilled to make it twice again in Hungary but this time with reversed layout, more speed, more danger and tons of fun!!!!! Round 5 & Nations Cup • Serres Racing Circuit • Greece • October 2–4 A classic that never disappoints. Supported by the incredible Serres management who give 200% for the sport, this weekend is a marathon of drifting: Thursday : Extra Training Day by the Circuit. Friday/Saturday: Pro2 & Queen Series Double Points Final. ProSeries Rd5. Sunday: The legendary Nations Cup, where drivers battle for national glory. The Grand Finale • Achna Speedway • Cyprus • October 16–18 In partnership with Cyprus Motorsport Federation. The final showdown. Under the Mediterranean stars, we return to the "Island of Drift" to crown the 2026 Pro Series Champion. Major Partners Driving the Drift Kings Vision The Drift Kings International Series is proud to continue its collaboration with three major sponsors for the 2026 season: DriftShop: As the title sponsor, DriftShop continues to provide world-class support for motorsport enthusiasts, offering top-quality parts for street, race, and drift cars. Their unwavering commitment to European drifting remains a cornerstone of the series. Learn more at https://www.driftshop.com Sentury Tires: The parent company of Landsail Tires and Kinforest Tires, Sentury Tires delivers top performance and quality for cars, SUVs, light trucks, and high-performance vehicles. Their focus on innovation ensures durability, precision, and excellent grip. Learn more: https://www.senturytireusa.com BK Clutch: With a legacy of crafting premium racing clutches for manual vehicles, BK Clutch ensures every driver gets the torque and durability needed for peak performance. Discover more at https://www.bkclutch.com . A MESSAGE FROM THE CEO "To the fans and drivers: 2026 is going to be amazing again," says CEO Michael Procureur. "We are blending the stability of our most trusted partners with the excitement of new frontiers like Bulgaria and Poland. While others chase the hype, we continue to build the legacy. Get ready for bigger battles and faster entries. We’ll see you at the start line." Drift fans can also look forward to the Asia Series calendar, which will be announced in Spring 2026. Stay tuned for an exciting and expanded Asia Series that promises to bring even more thrilling action to the international stage! RD4 Nitra ( PRO2 ) Aktuality 08.08.2026 Zakouřil conquers the Ostrava night. Dada wins final One More Time after a ten-minute repair Saturday’s battles at Dolní Vítkovice delivered two very different finals. Marco Zakouřil claimed the PRO victory with speed, aggressive initiations and pressure that Adrian Bartocha could not withstand in the decisive run. In PRO2, Arthur Dada overcame a mechanical failure, a frantic repair and a One More Time final against Jan Novotný. View full article 08.08.2026 Ostrava qualifying sets the battle order: Shevelov scores 95, Zelinka leads PRO2 The Race the Streets grand finale at Dolní Vítkovice opened with Friday qualifying. Valerii Shevelov delivered the highest-scoring run with 95 points. In PRO2, Zdeněk Zelinka and Radim Němeček both scored 83 points. Saturday will be decided in tandem battles.
